# Assets And Generated Files

## Assets

Assets live primarily under `public/` and feature-local asset folders. Binary assets are represented individually in `repository-map.json`, but area docs group them by consumer because pixel-level descriptions are not useful for maintenance.

Important asset categories include:

- `.webp` and `.png` image assets used by pages and feature UI.
- `.mp4` video assets served from `public/`.
- `.svg` vector assets used by UI or public pages.
- `.otf` font asset used by styles.

New browser-served assets should normally go under `public/` unless they are imported as module assets by a feature.

## Generated Or Reference Files

- `docs/repository-map/repository-map.json`: generated by `npm run docs:repo-map`. Do not manually edit generated structural fields.
- `package-lock.json`: generated by npm and committed to pin dependencies.
- `test-results/.last-run.json`: generated by Playwright and tracked in the current repository.
- `reports/` and feature report folders: historical QA or implementation evidence.
- `dist/` is build output and is not part of the tracked source inventory unless explicitly committed.

## Regeneration Risks

Generated artifacts can become stale when source files change. `npm run docs:repo-map:check` validates repository-map file hashes and fails if generated structural data no longer matches current file contents.
